clauses.title: Scope – Code numbers
clauses.text: 1.   Scope - Code numbers (in metric units), dimensional requirements, and physical and mechanical properties for a series of spot-welding electrodes, cap electrodes and shanks, mainly intented for resistance spot welding of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. This standard covers . electrodes with standard ISO tapers and with Morse tapers.

clauses.title: Specification for Electrodes with Standard ISO
clauses.text: 3. Specification for Electrodes with Standard ISO Tapers  -

clauses.title: The size of an
clauses.text: 3.1.1 The size of an electrode with taper engagement with dimensions of electrode shanks and electrode holders is given Table 1.

clauses.title: Straight electrodes with tapered shanks
clauses.text: 3.1.2 Straight electrodes with tapered shanks: Pointed, dome, flat, offset, truncated cone and spherical types. Overall length range from 38 to 102 mm for nominal sizes 1, 2 and 3 and 64 to 125 mm, 76 to 125 mm and 89 to 125 mm for nominal sizes 4, 9 and 10 respectively.

clauses.title: Electrode nose configurations –
clauses.text: 3.1.3 Electrode nose configurations - Types same as given in 3.1.2. Available in all sizes (1 to 10).

clauses.title: Standard single – Bend electrodes, cold-formed
clauses.text: 3.1.4 Standard single - Bend electrodes, cold-formed form standard straight electrodes: Pointed, dome, flat, eccentric and truncated types. Overall  length 64, 70, 83 and 83 for nominal sizes 5, 6, 7 and 8 respectively.

clauses.title: Standard double
clauses.text: 3.1.5 Standard double-bend electrodes, cold-formed from standard electrodes - Types, overall length and sizes are same as given in 3.1.4. clauses.title: Caps and adapter shanks Types A to F
clauses.text: 3.1.6 Caps and adapter shanks Types A to F. Nominal sizes 1 to 3. Note  1 - For dimensions of socket gauges for shanks, refer to Tables 2 and 3 with Fig. 1 of the standard. Note 2 - For electrode designations and other dimensional details, refer to Tables 1 and 4 to 8 and Fig. 2 of the standard.

clauses.title: Specification for Electrodes with Standard Morse
clauses.text: 4.  Specification for Electrodes with Standard Morse Tapers

clauses.title: Sizes and Dimensions
clauses.text: 4.1 Sizes and Dimensions — Nominal size 1, 2 and 3. Major dia 12.24, 15.87 and 22.22 mm for sizes 1, 2 and 3 respectively.

clauses.title: Morse electrode nose configurations – Pointed,
clauses.text: 4.1.1  Morse electrode nose configurations - Pointed, dome, flat, offset, truncated cone and spherical type. Nose lengths  (19.0 and 6.5 mm),  (22.0  and 10.0 mm) and (28.5 and 10.0 mm) for nominal sizes 1, 2 and 3 respectively in case of pointed and dome types.

clauses.title: Straight electrode with tapered
clauses.text: 4.1.2 Straight electrode with tapered shanks - Types same as given in 4.1.1. Overall length range 32 to 102 mm for sizes 1 and 2 and 38 to 102 mm for size 3.

clauses.title: Single
clauses.text: 4.1.3 Single-bend electrodes, cold-formed from standard straight electrodes - Pointed, dome, flat, eccentric and truncated types. Overall length 64, 70 and 83 mm for nominal sizes 1, 2 and 3 respectively.

clauses.title: Double
clauses.text: 4.1.4 Double-bend electrodes; cold-formed from standard straight electrodes - Types, overall lengths and sizes are same as given in 4.1.3.

clauses.title: Morse caps and adapter
clauses.text: 4.1.5 Morse caps and adapter shanks Types A to F. Note 1- For dimensions of shanks of electrodes, refer to Fig. 3 and for taper ring and plug gauges, refer to Table 9 of the standard. Note 2 - For electrode designations and other dimensional details, refer to Tables 10 to 14 and Fig. 4 of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 4972 : 1968 Specifications for resistance spot - welding electrodes.
